summary: Biophytis S.A., a French pharmaceutical company, filed a Form 6-K on August 27, 2026, reporting the issuance of its 2025 Financial Report on July 29, 2026. The filing is routine disclosure of annual financial results under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 for foreign private issuers. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or restructuring is disclosed. The exhibit contains the financial report in PDF format. This is a standard periodic report with no actionable corporate event.
